description: MLX Omni Server is a local inference server powered by Apple's MLX framework, specifically designed for Apple Silicon (M-series) chips. It implements OpenAI-compatible API endpoints, enabling seamless integration with existing OpenAI SDK clients while leveraging the power of local ML inference.
